name: checked-expression-operator-test-30b071e6cd/checked-expr-with-no-error-type-v.bal
spec_references: Other invocation restrictions: "error:message" and "value:toString" are listed as supported langlib method calls
reason: The case exercises supported check expressions on boolean operands without error members, including boolean singleton aliases and unions, and their use as conditional-expression conditions. Successful execution must return from the first check-true branch and preserve each selected error value for message equality assertions. All essential constructs and invoked langlib methods are covered, with no applicable restriction excluding this behavior.
test_design_notes: No @args, @panic or @output directives occur. main runs both test functions and should complete without panic or output.
In check b1 ? err : err and its variants, check applies to the boolean condition; the selected error is asserted via message(), rather than propagated by check.
The io:println call is disabled instrumentation under a false flag. Assertion failures and the unreachable branch panic explicitly.
